summary: Stop recommending akasper/plate_template on the bootstrap path; new repos use gh plate bootstrap and upgrades use plate-core import-payload/self-migrate.
migration_impact: Downstream repos should remove plate_template upstream remotes from agent docs and onboarding. Legacy plate_template forks upgrade via gh plate tooling only.
migration_guidance: 1. Do not create, clone, or sync from akasper/plate_template; start new repos with gh plate bootstrap.
2. Replace git-fetch upstream template sync instructions with gh plate self-migrate and gh plate import-payload.
3. Remove template_repository: akasper/plate_template from .agentic/process.yml if present; use methodology_repository: akasper/plate.
4. PLATE_ALLOW_LEGACY_TEMPLATE_SIBLING=1 enables deprecated sibling plate_template resolution only for exceptional local dev.
agent_notes: Closes #1151. plate_template mentions in migration/cutover research docs remain intentional legacy history.
